title: Gut Microbiome Analysis in Mice
author: Trina Knotts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ynkfvcw

steps.title: Prepare Mice for Collection
steps.instruction: House mice singly in clean cages with fresh food, water, and low bedding.

steps.title: Record Initial Weights
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse and the initial amount of rodent diet provided ("food-in") in grams.

steps.title: Save Diet Samples
steps.instruction: Save several pellets of rodent diet for analysis (e.g., energy or macronutrient content) and store them at 4°C in an airtight container.

steps.title: Perform 24-Hour Weight Check
steps.instruction: At 24h, weigh the mouse and the remaining rodent diet ("food-out") in grams.

steps.title: Perform 48-Hour Final Weight Check
steps.instruction: At the end of the 48h collection period, weigh the mouse and the remaining rodent diet ("food-out").

steps.title: Collect Fecal Samples
steps.instruction: Carefully collect all feces from the cage bottom and prepare for storage.

substeps.instruction: Inspect and remove each piece of bedding using tweezers to collect all feces.
Inspect each fecal pellet to ensure no spilled food, hair fibers, or bedding are attached.
If significant food spillage is found in the cage bottom, weigh it in a pre-tared weigh boat to add back to food measurements.
Place feces in a labeled, pre-weighed 1.5 ml tube.
Subtract the tube weight from the total weight to determine fecal "wet" weight.

steps.title: Reset Housing
steps.instruction: Return animals to the housing system after replacing cage bottoms, feeder inserts, and water bottles with new clean ones.

steps.title: Store and Ship Samples
steps.instruction: Store fecal samples at -80°C until they are shipped on dry ice to UCDavis MBP for 16S DNA amplicon sequencing and analysis.

substeps.instruction: Ship to: Mouse Biology Program C/O UC Davis MMPC, University of California, 2795 Second Street, Suite 400, Davis, CA 95618 (530-757-3333).
Include the MBP/MMPC project # in the reference section of package documentation.
Send the FedEx/UPS tracking number to mmpc-bodyc@ucdavis.edu.
